title: 663. Design Circular Deque

examples.explanation: Capacity 3 fills with [3,1,2]; the second insertFront fails; rear is 2 and the deque is full; after deleting the rear, inserting 4 at the front gives [4,3,1].
An empty deque reads -1 at both ends; after inserting 9 it is neither full nor empty.

hints: Hold a fixed buffer with a head index and a count; every end maps to (head + offset) mod k.
insertFront moves head backward first, insertLast writes at head + count; both fail when count equals k.
Deletes move head forward or shrink count, and getters answer -1 only when count is zero.
